[EN] So many disappearing into the mines. So few coming out.

And the ones that do come out, of course, are nowhere near the people that they were when they went inside.
[ES] Tantos desaparecen en las minas. Muy pocos salen.

Y los que salen, por supuesto, ya no se parecen en nada a las personas que eran cuando entraron.
